items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Bobby Morris, Charles Nelson Reilley, all those people. I didn’t know who they were.

ctx.x: Bobby Morris, Charles Nelson Reilley, all those people. I didn’t know who they were. I mean I knew Rudy Vallée. I said, “you want to work with Rudy Vallée?”
What’s he going to bring his megaphone?
